title: The Duluth Lakewalk
specs: Over eight miles of paved pedestrian and bicycle trail along Lake Superior
Pollinator gardens maintained along the Lakewalk to support monarch butterflies and other pollinators
Historical sites including Uncle Harvey’s mausoleum, Endion Station, and geological features like glacial grooves and volcanic rock
gap: No age or physical fitness requirements stated
blurb: The Duluth Lakewalk is an over eight-mile paved trail for walking, biking, and other exercise along Lake Superior's shore. It features natural areas, pollinator gardens, historical sites, and multiple access points with parking and amenities. Friends of the Lakewalk is a volunteer organization that supports maintenance, improvements, and advocacy for the Lakewalk.
extraNote: Lakewalk closures and detours during construction from August 2026 through October 2026, with winter pause and resumption in spring 2027 · Friends of the Lakewalk depends on volunteers and members for activities and improvements
